activity.notes: The extraordinary parliament in Guangzhou elected Sun grand marshal on 1 September 1917; he assumed office on 10 September and resigned in May 1918 as the military government was reorganized into a directorate. ATLAS models this southern Constitutional Protection government separately from the Beijing-based national administration.

sources.title: Chronology of Dr. Sun Yat-sen — National Dr. Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
sources.citation_text: Official chronology records Sun's 1912 provisional presidency, 1917-1918 grand-marshal leadership of the Constitutional Protection government, 1921-1922 Guangzhou presidency, and restoration as grand marshal in 1923.
